overview: Docket (1930-39) indexes Nagasaki railway construction, the Echigo-Yamate tramway scandal, South Manchuria Railway leadership turmoil, a Honshu-Kyushu tunnel plan, proposed Chinese purchases of U.S. railway materials, and State-RFC deliberations over selling Lehigh Valley locomotives to Japanese interests.

subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers concerning railways in Japan
subfiles.about: An archival index summarizes and cross-references Japanese railway records dating chiefly from 1930 through 1939.
subfiles.summary: Lists records on Nagasaki railway extension, Japanese railway reports, the Echigo-Yamate tramway scandal, South Manchuria Railway leadership controversy, a Honshu-Kyushu tunnel plan, Chinese railway-material purchase proposals, and State-RFC-Lehigh Valley locomotive sale discussions.

interest: Shows 1930s Japanese railway scandals, construction, and sensitive Lehigh Valley locomotive sales discussions.
